title: Scalar comparison of vector integration counits
statement: For an independently integration-normalized vector purity family, the full prescribed scalar-reduction compatibility law holds, with the canonical source comparison and actual exceptional mate. This is one compatibility clause, not the vector-bundle purity theorem.

source.place: paragraph 2; assembly step 5, normalized transpose in the published vector-purity coordinates

proof.text: Obtain the annihilator and degree-one normalized Tate line comparison from the scalar source normalization theorem.
Apply normalized vector-bundle purity over the target coefficient ring to obtain its normalized family and invertible components.
Apply the fixed-witness scalar compatibility calculation and package its clauses with the chosen annihilator, line comparison and target family.
